must_identify.item: The api cannot reach redis (connection timeouts), which is why /api/ returns 5xx; redis itself is healthy
The cause is the NetworkPolicy redis, which allows ingress to redis only from app=worker, not from the api

notes: K8sGPT reported 'No problems detected' while a critical 100% 5xx alert was firing, so it gave no root cause and no fix. Its analyzers look for unhealthy resources and likely do not evaluate whether a NetworkPolicy blocks an otherwise healthy traffic path.
